messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: release v3.14.0 -> prod. Change window 23:00-01:00 UTC. Canary rollout 5% (triggered by CI #deploy/789).

maya: copying — preflight checks passed, SLO snapshots attached.

jamie_oncall: oncall watching p95 and 5xx. Alert thresholds set: p95 > 350ms OR 5xx > 0.5% -> notify paging.

ci-bot: Preflight metrics snapshot: error_budget_remaining=98% | p95_latency_ms=320 | 5xx_rate=0.12% | sample_qps=1.2k.

lee_sre: eyeballing embeddings route — small bump in us-west-2, 5xx at 0.43% over last 30s. could hit 0.6% if noisy. canary at 5% might amplify.

maya: thanks Lee. recommend we pause ramp at 10% and run quick diagnostic. Signal committee: vote to HOLD and pin to v3.13.9 if 5xx > 0.6% sustained 3m. React with :thumbsup: to hold, :thumbsdown: to continue.

zoe_pm: hold for now — product prefers safety, minimal customer impact.

ryan_ops: starting quick log pull and trace aggregation (logs -> /ops/runs/4789012345).

alex_eng: can we route embeddings to stable fallback (v3.13.9-quant) instead of full rollback? softer mitigation.

lee_sre: agree with alex. fallback will reduce exposure and let other telemetry settle. do we have an automated pin command?

maya: yes — we can pin route. Command: /route pin embeddings v3.13.9-quant (will route 100% embeddings to stable model). Doing pin + hold at canary 5% until next check.

deploy-bot: Received command: /route pin embeddings v3.13.9-quant — applying now. Canary unchanged at 5% and holding.

ci-bot: Canary metrics (t+7m): p95=335ms | 5xx=0.22% | embeddings_us-west-2=0.18% after pin.

lee_sre: error rate dropped after pinning. I'll continue monitoring for 10m and post a follow-up. If 5xx creeps back >0.6% we'll propose rollback.

jamie_oncall: added autosnooze: unpin_if_rollback_threshold => false; also set alert escalation to paging for any region >0.5% 5xx. updated change window notes. :white_check_mark:

zoe_pm: updating release notes draft: "embeddings traffic briefly routed to stable model during canary due to transient errors; no customer-facing impact."

maya: signal committee check — resume ramp to 20% in 15m if no objections. thumbs?

ryan_ops: +1

alex_eng: +1

lee_sre: +1

jamie_oncall: +1

deploy-bot: Scheduled: ramp to 20% in 15m unless new hold command appears. Thread id=4789012345. Logging audit -> /deploy/audit/4789012345. :robot_face:
